---
params:
  x: NULL
  title: "LAGO optimization report"
title: "`r params$title`"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    theme: cosmo
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
x <- params$x
# lago_blocks() is the shared presentation formatter; the report renders from
# the same blocks as print.lago()/summary.lago() so the two can never drift.
# It is an internal helper, hence the triple-colon access.
blocks <- LAGO:::lago_blocks(x)
```

## `r blocks$recommendation$title`

```{r recommendation}
rec_rows <- blocks$recommendation$rows
if (!is.null(rec_rows$component)) {
  knitr::kable(
    rec_rows,
    col.names = c("Component", "Value"),
    align = c("l", "r")
  )
} else {
  knitr::kable(
    rec_rows,
    col.names = "Value",
    align = "r"
  )
}
```

## `r blocks$cost$title`

```{r cost, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("- ", blocks$cost$rows), sep = "\n")
```

## `r blocks$outcome$title`

```{r outcome, results='asis'}
cat(paste0("- ", blocks$outcome$rows), sep = "\n")
```

```{r power, results='asis', eval=!is.null(blocks$power)}
cat("## ", blocks$power$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(paste0("- ", blocks$power$rows), sep = "\n")
```

```{r confidence-set-text, results='asis', eval=!is.null(blocks$confidence_set)}
cat("## ", blocks$confidence_set$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(paste0("- ", blocks$confidence_set$rows), sep = "\n")
```

```{r confidence-set-head, eval=!is.null(blocks$confidence_set)}
knitr::kable(
  utils::head(x$cs),
  caption = "First rows of the confidence set"
)
```

```{r test, results='asis', eval=!is.null(blocks$test)}
cat("## ", blocks$test$title, "\n\n", sep = "")
cat(paste0("- ", blocks$test$rows), sep = "\n")
```

```{r plot-heading, results='asis', eval=!is.null(x$cs)}
cat("## Confidence set plot\n")
```

```{r plot, eval=!is.null(x$cs), fig.width=7, fig.height=5}
plot(x)
```
